title: His mother's organ and the sleeping organ teacher
summary: His mother plays hymns on the organ; he sneaks ragtime on it while his teacher sleeps.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: My mother had an organ. She used to sing sometimes, "Jesus, lover of all my soul", and I can hear some of these women singing now the way she was just singing. Anyhow, she'd sit down there and play for you with two fingers, "Jesus, lover of all my soul", and belt it out.
But when we'd get on the organ, I had a teacher, but this fellow would do a whole lot of sleeping. And as he was
asleep, I'd go in to try to play one of these ragtime things. Course we didn't know anything about swing and bop and those things then. It was only the ragtime, see.
